faq.question: Is an EV practical in Pune?
faq.answer: For most daily commuters under 80–100 km/day with home or workplace charging, yes — traffic patterns in Pune often suit EV efficiency.

faq.question: What should I check before buying an EV in Pune?
faq.answer: Confirm apartment or workplace charging access, realistic commute distance, and on-road price with a local dealer.
